note: The inventory of what meets on the chart, for the colour co-occurrence matrix of PRD-0002 S3 (#48 section 4). Hand-authored from docs/visual-contract.md's consumer rows and from the role tables of src/encoding.js; tests/unit/color-matrix.test.js checks that it is complete against those tables (every reference family, every signed role, every state ink) and that every claim of `forms` is true of the live tables, and tests/reference/color-matrix.js turns it into docs/color-matrix.md.

kinds.area: a filled cell or band: identified by its place on the chart, the legend and the readout
kinds.stroke: a reference line or a drawn mark: identified by its label, its pattern and its endpoint glyph
kinds.outline: an outline, a bracket or a pattern drawn on its own opaque ground (the surface)
kinds.plate: a control or plane tile: identified by its glyph, its label and its position

forms.label: a name on the chart or in the control, in ink on an opaque plate
forms.pattern: a dash, dot or hatch pattern keyed in the footer
forms.glyph: an endpoint, a corner bracket, a shape painted in the mark's own ink
forms.sign: the plus, minus and ring of E.role.SIGN where the cell is 12 px or more
forms.legend: the generated legend: its ramp, its ticks and its marker
forms.number: the exact value in the readout, the table and Inspect
forms.position: where the mark is (the Rows strip, the profile track, the plane's cell)

roleCodes.note: The target-role codes of docs/visual-contract.md's Target role column and the carriers each stands for: every code of the inventory is here, and every code here is in the inventory (tests/unit/color-matrix.test.js). CHR is the text and the chrome on opaque plates, which has contrast rows (U19, B43) and no hue pair.
